response.justification: Bogdan brings roughly 15+ years of hands-on, polyglot engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and high-throughput backend systems, plus founder experience with an open-source geo-data platform and a strong record of teaching and public speaking. However, the role is a director-level IC focused on AI strategy, cloud product direction, and advising strategic enterprise customers — areas where the resume shows little evidence. AI/ML exposure is limited to recent MCP/agent tooling rather than recognized AI expertise or shipped AI products, cloud work is application-level (AWS CDK, Kubernetes deploys) rather than platform strategy, and the career trajectory tops out at Staff/Senior IC without demonstrated organization-wide technical leadership or executive-facing influence.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, deep hands-on engineering across many stacks and domains
Founder of GISCollective and active OSS author — entrepreneurial, builder mindset
Strong knowledge-sharing track record: conference talks, workshops, courses
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise or AI products at scale
No director-level or principal-scope influence; peaks at Staff/Senior IC
Little evidence of cloud platform strategy or advising strategic customers

key_factors.factor: AI expertise and shipped AI products
Seniority and strategic scope vs. director-level IC bar
Depth and breadth of hands-on engineering experience
